items.title: National Theatre Live: The Misanthrope
items.overview: Alice, a brilliant novelist, despises the hollow contemporary mantras of kindness and respect. But the bolder she becomes in speaking out, the more colleagues avoid her, and the more her personal relationships begin to fracture. As she challenges fashionable ideas and lends her voice to causes others are afraid to touch, she faces intense criticism and backlash. Alice will soon learn the price she must pay as an artist and as a woman for daring to speak her mind. Award-winner Sandra Oh is the Misanthrope in Martin Crimp's cutting new version of Molière's dark comedy, directed by National Theatre Director Indhu Rubasingham.

items.title: One Last Shot - Végső ostrom
items.overview: A tapasztalt Navy SEAL, Jake Harris újra akcióba lép, amikor egy volt bajtársa fenyegeti a világot. Hogy megakadályozza a terv irányítóját a nukleáris kódok megszerzésében, Harris ellenséges területre vezeti csapatát, ahol zsoldosokkal, halálos csapdákkal és saját zűrös múltjával néz szembe. Főszerepben Scott Adkins, Steven Cree, Hannah Ware és Dolph Lundgren.

items.title: Another Day
items.overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

items.title: Possible Love
items.overview: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

items.title: Eine Nacht in Bangkok
items.overview: Katharina and Hektor who used to be married ten years ago meet again after their daughter Lilith is suspected of serial burglary.

items.title: The Paradise
items.overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

items.title: Shame and Money
items.overview: After losing their livelihood in a village, a Kosovar family is forced to move to the capital in pursuit of a place in a hypercapitalist society.

items.title: Butterfly
items.overview: Two sisters raised on a charter resort in Gran Canaria. After 27 years, they reluctantly return to their childhood island to deal with their parents death, and end up with a half-finished esoteric retreat center in the Canary Islands.

items.title: He Calls Me Daughter
items.overview: A documentary exploring the lasting impact of the father wound on women and the hope, healing, and restored identity found through the love of God as the perfect Father.

items.title: Verity
items.overview: owen Ashleigh író megélhetési nehézégekkel szembesül, ezért igent mond egy állásajánlatra, amely élete nagy lehetőségének bizonyul. Jeremy Crawford, a bestsellerszerző Verity Crawford férje felbéreli őt, ugyanis felesége egy rejtélyes baleset következtében félbehagyta műveit. A férj Ashleigh-re bízná a befejezést, ám ahogy az író megérkezik a birtokra és munkához lát, egy félkész kéziratot talál, melyből kiderül egy családi titok. Ashleigh feladata rájönni, hogy Verity írásai a fantázia szüleményei, vagy baljós előrejelzések...  (Szarka Károly)

items.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
items.overview: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

items.title: Judge Judy: Unfiltered, Unforgettable
items.overview: For three decades, JUDGE JUDY has been a fixture in homes across America and around the world, making Judge Judy one of the most recognizable and influential personalities in television history. Audiences worldwide know her razor-sharp wit, unwavering common sense and unmistakable courtroom authority, with an influence that extends far beyond television.

items.title: Possible Love
items.overview: Four strangers' paths cross by chance, leading to complex emotional entanglements that challenge their existing relationships and force them to confront uncomfortable truths about love and commitment.

items.title: Unabomber
items.overview: In this drama inspired by true events, Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy to the infamous Unabomber unfolds as the FBI hunts him down.

items.title: Victorian Psycho
items.overview: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

items.title: The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest
items.overview: A rational urban man defies his ancestral village's forbidden forest and awakens a divine goddess, forcing him to confront powers beyond logic as he becomes the unlikely saviour protecting his people from annihilation.

items.title: Bill's Cube
items.overview: Bill, an underachieving stoner is approached by a businessman with a plan that includes corporate espionage and time travel.

items.title: Brother Save Us
items.overview: A 12-year-old boy in the Midwest befriends an AI farmworker, creating tension with his brother while their father battles illness.
